title: Action-Conditioned Spatio-Temporal Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.27044v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study spatio-temporal forecasting in networked systems under specified actions. The challenge is to capture the action's effects without predicting spurious changes in unaffected regions. However, direct supervision and evaluation of these effects require paired futures with and without the action, whereas observational trajectories reveal only the realized future. We introduce PairST, a benchmark comprising six datasets across traffic, power transmission and water distribution, with paired reference and intervened futures simulated from the same system state. These pairs enable separate evaluation of affected-region forecast accuracy and quiet-region response error. We further propose ActionST, which forecasts the intervened future by writing an explicit response onto an intervention-independent reference forecast. translated_title: 动作条件下的时空预测
translated_abstract: 我们研究在指定动作条件下网络化系统中的时空预测问题。其挑战在于如何捕捉动作产生的影响，同时避免在未受影响区域预测出虚假变化。然而，对这些影响的直接监督和评估需要有动作与无动作两种情形下成对的未来状态，而观测轨迹只能揭示实际发生的未来。我们提出了PairST，一个包含六个数据集的基准，涵盖交通、电力传输和供水分配领域，其中参考未来与干预未来是从同一系统状态模拟得到的成对数据。这些成对数据使得可以分别评估受影响区域的预测精度和未受影响区域的响应误差。我们进一步提出ActionST，该方法通过在与干预无关的参考预测上写入显式的动作响应来预测干预后的未来。具体而言，节点-时间寻址为每个响应位置构建查询，状态条件化的响应写入器……
tldr: 该论文提出了PairST基准（涵盖交通、电力传输和供水分配的六个数据集，提供同一系统状态下有无干预动作的成对未来数据）以及ActionST方法，通过在与干预无关的参考预测上写入显式动作响应，实现对受影响区域动作效果与未受影响区域不变性的分别评估。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PairST, a benchmark of six datasets across traffic, power transmission, and water distribution with paired reference and intervened futures simulated from the same system state, and ActionST, a method that forecasts intervened futures by writing an explicit action response onto an intervention-independent reference forecast, enabling separate evaluation of affected-region accuracy and unaffected-region invariance.
